title: Titrating phosphoric acid
caption: Phosphoric acid gives up its protons one at a time, so titrating it with NaOH shows a separate rise for each: at 25 cm³ (H₂PO₄⁻) and 50 cm³ (HPO₄²⁻). The third proton (pKa 12.35) is too weak to give a visible end point in water.
alt: Titration curve of 25 cm³ of 0.1 mol dm⁻³ H₃PO₄ with 0.1 mol dm⁻³ NaOH: steep rises at 25 and 50 cm³, then a gradual climb.
description: First rise at 25 cm³, from about pH 3 to 6.
Second rise at 50 cm³, from about pH 8 to 11.
